chunks: And from a sermon of his (peace be upon him), in which he describes the Arabs before the Proclamation, then he describes his own state before the pledge of allegiance to him [The Arabs before the Proclamation].
ai.seo_question: What does Imam Ali describe in his sermon regarding the Arabs before Prophethood?
ai.summary: This heading introduces a sermon where Imam Ali (AS) contrasts the pre-Islamic moral decay of the Arabs with his own deliberate patience and readiness before accepting the Caliphate. It highlights the Shia scholarly emphasis on his legitimacy and the strategic timing of his leadership, distinguishing his acceptance of authority from mere political opportunism.
